from functools import partial

import requests

def worker(name, que):
    que.put("%d is done" % name)

import multiprocessing
from multiprocessing import Queue, Manager
import time
import requests

def worker(name, que):
    que.put("%d is done" % name)

def main():
    m = Manager()
    q = m.Queue()
    pool = multiprocessing.Pool(processes=3)
    workers = pool.map(worker, [(i, q) for i in range(3)])
    for w in workers:
        w.wait()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import multiprocessing
import win32clipboard
import requests

def worker(name, que):
    que.put("%d is done" % name)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    pool = multiprocessing.Pool(processes=3)
    m = multiprocessing.Manager()
    q = m.Queue()
    workers = pool.apply_async(worker, (33, q))
    while not q.empty():
        data = q.get()
        with win32clipboard.OpenClipboard():
            win32clipboard.SetClipboardData(data)
        requests.post("https://anothermachine.com", data={"clipboard": data})
